cards.text: You mention Des. Archie's face does the thing it does, which is nothing at all, quite deliberately.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "He's good at ground. Best I know. Leave it there."
He very obviously wants to leave it there.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result_text: You leave it. He looks briefly grateful and then annoyed with himself for looking grateful.
